conditions.database: Fresh isolated .local temporary SQLite file, schema3; closed and removed after measurements. Never opens app/student data.
conditions.sampling: 5 untimed-cohort warmup calls plus 100 measured calls per metric; six metrics. Create adds 105 notes; edit updates one seeded note 105 times. Page/count metrics therefore observe 605 live notes. Warmup failures are retained.
conditions.timer: performance.now(); includes production validation/transaction/SQL prepare/decoding/receipt work and file commit for mutations. Assertions, fixture/migration/TS compilation and cleanup are outside each measured call.
conditions.percentiles: Nearest rank ceil(p*n) over successful samples; all 100 measured samples including failures retained; durations rounded to six decimals.
conditions.controls: No forced GC, cache eviction or background-process isolation. Concurrent capstone development/build activity was not stopped. Host scheduling, filesystem cache and device firmware durability are uncontrolled.
conditions.limits: Page20 bounds returned JS records (SQLite may return 21 to detect hasMore), not SQL scan cost. LIKE body search can scan history. File-backed FULL synchronous is a host configuration, not Android/JSI or power-loss proof.
conditions.exclusions: No Android device, UI rendering, native alarm, speech/audio, cloud/backend, private data, battery, startup, peak PSS, low-RAM acceptance or old/new speed comparison.
